Why do you think Ben's cheeks were red and he was breathing fast?
items.answer: Ben had been running or playing hard outside.

steps: Muddy shoes mean Ben was outside. Red cheeks and fast breathing happen when you run or play hard. So Ben was probably running around outside before he came in.

items.answer: Aisha felt happy and proud of her friend.

Why do you think Zoe's mind went blank?
items.answer: Zoe was nervous about performing in front of an audience, and the nerves made her forget her lines.

steps: Performing on stage in front of people is scary. Nervousness can make your mind go blank even if you practiced. The story shows Zoe needed a prompt from her teacher to remember her lines.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Marco wanted to eat cake for breakfast. His dad said no and gave him oatmeal. Marco pushed the oatmeal away. An hour later, he was very hungry.

What lesson could Marco learn from this experience?
items.answer: Marco could learn that refusing to eat a good meal has consequences. It is better to eat what you are given so you are not hungry later.

steps: Marco refused his oatmeal because he wanted cake instead. Later he was very hungry. That hunger is the result of his choice. This connects action to consequence and teaches that it is important to eat healthy food even if it is not your first choice.

items.prompt:
Read the story below.

Every day, Leo told his mom he was fine when she asked how school was going. One day, his teacher called home. Leo had been sitting alone at lunch all week.

Why do you think Leo kept saying he was fine? What can you figure out from the details?
items.answer: Leo probably did not want to worry his mom or admit he was struggling. The details show he was actually having a hard time but was hiding it.

steps: Leo said 'fine' every day, but the teacher's call revealed the truth. Children sometimes hide problems because they feel embarrassed, do not want to worry their parents, or do not know how to ask for help. The detail about sitting alone all week shows Leo was not fine at all. The contrast between his words and the reality is the key.
